rules: 1 instruction/task = 1 literal node; one active owner per node.
No new feature/framework/download/documentation unless directly required to close a listed GAP.
REUSE_EXISTING > PATCH > ADAPT; GENERATE only when a concrete missing artifact is proven.
Every node executes VERIFY_RESEARCH -> EXECUTE_DELTA -> TEST_REPORT.
No PASS without exact path/blob or SHA + test + trusted CI/readback when applicable.
If a node exposes a new concrete blocker, record it as a child GAP of the same closure chain; do not broaden scope.
Fresh-read claims before writes; collision => release and take next non-overlapping node.
Global close requires all nodes below CLOSED and Final Judge PASS.
